-- KPIs NOC. Una sola consulta alimenta los 6 indicadores (paneles 1000-1005).
-- r = fin exclusivo de la ventana 'actual': el ultimo minuto de la ABT o el fin
--     del rango, lo que sea anterior. Mirando un incidente pasado, alcanza con
--     cerrar el rango en el momento que se quiere revisar.
WITH gm AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(minuto_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS m FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring WHERE fecha_particion >= date_format(date_add('day',-1,current_date),'%Y-%m-%d')),
lim AS (SELECT m AS gm, LEAST(date_trunc('minute',CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)), m) AS r FROM gm),
b AS (SELECT CAST(a.minuto_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS ts, TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) AS cr, TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje) AS cmsg, NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri, CASE WHEN a.instrmtyp IN('VD','VK','V6','VB','VN','SR','VC') THEN 'Visa' WHEN a.instrmtyp IN('MD','MC','MS','MK') THEN 'Mastercard' WHEN a.instrmtyp='AX' THEN 'Amex' WHEN a.instrmtyp='PA' THEN 'Cabal' WHEN a.instrmtyp='UC' THEN 'UPI' ELSE 'Otra' END AS marca_f, TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f, CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm, IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4, substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4), TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) AS gw, a.latencia_ms AS lat FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER) WHERE a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('minute',-375,date_add('day',-1,$__timeTo()))),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND ((a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour',-12,$__timeTo()) AND a.minuto_utc < $__timeTo()) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('minute',-375,date_add('day',-1,$__timeTo())) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('day',-1,$__timeTo()))) AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30') AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'PB' THEN 'Marcas Privadas'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)'
                   ELSE 'Otro'
              END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
x AS (SELECT ts FROM filt WHERE cmsg<>'1420'),
k AS (SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.r - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND ts < l.r THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n5,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.r - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE AND ts < l.r THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n15,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.r - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND ts < l.r - INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n15d1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ts >= l.r - INTERVAL '6' HOUR AND ts < l.r THEN ts END) AS lt
  FROM x CROSS JOIN lim l)
SELECT
  date_format(l.r - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%d/%m %H:%i') || ' hs' AS ultimo_minuto,
  date_diff('minute', l.gm, CAST(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp)) AS atraso_min,
  CAST((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END) AS varchar) || ' min' AS resolucion,
  ROUND(k.n5 / 5.0, 1) AS trx_min,
  ROUND(100.0 * k.n15 / NULLIF(k.n15d1, 0), 1) AS pct_vs_d1,
  date_diff('minute', k.lt, l.r - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE) AS silencio_min
FROM lim l CROSS JOIN k

-- Procesamiento completo en TRX por minuto: actual y mismo horario de D-1.
-- Tambien devuelve % vs D-1 y latencia, que usan los paneles 1011 y 1012.
WITH gm AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(minuto_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS m FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring WHERE fecha_particion >= date_format(date_add('day',-1,current_date),'%Y-%m-%d')),
lim AS (SELECT date_trunc('minute',CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)) AS t0, LEAST(date_trunc('minute',CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)), (SELECT m FROM gm)) AS t1),
b AS (SELECT CAST(a.minuto_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS ts, TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) AS cr, TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje) AS cmsg, NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri, CASE WHEN a.instrmtyp IN('VD','VK','V6','VB','VN','SR','VC') THEN 'Visa' WHEN a.instrmtyp IN('MD','MC','MS','MK') THEN 'Mastercard' WHEN a.instrmtyp='AX' THEN 'Amex' WHEN a.instrmtyp='PA' THEN 'Cabal' WHEN a.instrmtyp='UC' THEN 'UPI' ELSE 'Otra' END AS marca_f, TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f, CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm, IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4, substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4), TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) AS gw, a.latencia_ms AS lat FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER) WHERE a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('day',-1,$__timeFrom())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND ((a.minuto_utc >= $__timeFrom() AND a.minuto_utc < $__timeTo()) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('day',-1,$__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('day',-1,$__timeTo()))) AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30') AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'PB' THEN 'Marcas Privadas'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.instrmtyp) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)'
                   ELSE 'Otro'
              END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ts >= l.t0 THEN 'act' ELSE 'd1' END AS serie,
  CASE WHEN ts >= l.t0 THEN ts ELSE ts + INTERVAL '1' DAY END AS tsa, cr, cmsg, lat
  FROM filt CROSS JOIN lim l
  WHERE (ts >= l.t0 AND ts < l.t1)
     OR (ts >= l.t0 - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND ts < l.t1 - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND ts < l.t0)),
agg AS (SELECT date_trunc('minute',tsa)-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM tsa)%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS time, serie,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aprob,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND cr NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deneg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rev,
  approx_percentile(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND lat >= 0 THEN CAST(lat AS double) END, 0.95) AS p95,
  approx_percentile(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND lat >= 0 THEN CAST(lat AS double) END, 0.50) AS p50
  FROM x GROUP BY 1, 2),
grid AS (SELECT g AS time FROM lim CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CASE WHEN lim.t1 > date_trunc('minute',GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE THEN sequence(date_trunc('minute',GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, lim.t1 - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE) ELSE CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(timestamp)) END) AS t(g))
SELECT g.time,
  ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(a.total,0) / NULLIF(date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)),0), 1) AS "Total TRX/min",
  ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(a.aprob,0) / NULLIF(date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)),0), 1) AS "Aprobadas/min",
  ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(a.deneg,0) / NULLIF(date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)),0), 1) AS "Denegadas/min",
  ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(a.rev,0) / NULLIF(date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)),0), 1) AS "Reversos/min",
  ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(d.total,0) / NULLIF(date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)),0), 1) AS "Total D-1 TRX/min",
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(a.total,0) / NULLIF(d.total,0), 1) AS "% vs D-1",
  ROUND(a.p95, 0) AS "Latencia p95 (ms)",
  ROUND(a.p50, 0) AS "Latencia p50 (ms)"
FROM grid g CROSS JOIN lim l
LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.time = g.time AND a.serie = 'act'
LEFT JOIN agg d ON d.time = g.time AND d.serie = 'd1'
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSQL:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_parse(concat(a.fechalocalautorizacion,a.horalocalautorizacion),'%y%m%d%H%i%s') AS timestamp)+INTERVAL '3' HOUR AS ts,
    TRIM(a.codrespuestaautorizacion) AS cr,
    TRIM(a.codtipomensajeautorizacion) AS cmsg,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),'') AS ciss,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri,
    CASE WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('VD','VK','V6','VB','VN','SR','VC') THEN 'Visa' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('MD','MC','MS','MK') THEN 'Mastercard' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='AX' THEN 'Amex' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='PA' THEN 'Cabal' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='UC' THEN 'UPI' ELSE 'Otra' END AS marca_f,
    TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f,
    substr(regexp_extract(TRIM(a.nrotarjeta),'^[0-9]+'),1,8) AS bin8,
    CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm
  FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.ctx_autorizaciones_eps a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER)
  WHERE a.fecha BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeFrom()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d')
    AND TRIM(a.codprocesoautorizacion1) NOT IN('92','30')
    AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) IN (SELECT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(e.cuit_establecimiento_host,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)))
    AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) NOT IN (SELECT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE e.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(REPLACE(e.cuit_establecimiento_host,'-','') AS BIGINT) IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419)))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) = 'PB' THEN 'Marcas Privadas'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura'
                   WHEN TRIM(a.INSTRMTYP) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)'
                   ELSE 'Otro'
              END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )
),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
denegados AS (
  SELECT ts, bin8 FROM filt 
  WHERE ts>=$__timeFrom() AND ts<$__timeTo() 
    AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') 
    AND bin8 IS NOT NULL AND bin8<>''
),
top10 AS (SELECT bin8, COUNT(*) AS n FROM denegados GROUP BY bin8 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT date_trunc('minute',d.ts)-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM d.ts)%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS time,
  d.bin8 AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS rechazos
FROM denegados d JOIN top10 t ON d.bin8=t.bin8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
